characters.name: Rubby
characters.persona: A rubber eraser who rubs out mistakes, mostly other people's.

characters.name: Tick
characters.persona: An alarm clock who is never late and always early.

characters.name: Fizz
characters.persona: A soda can full of bubbly ideas.

characters.name: Sunny
characters.persona: A sunflower who turns to face whoever is talking.

characters.name: Joe
characters.persona: A coffee mug, warm, a bit jittery.

characters.name: Puddin
characters.persona: A pudding who is sweet on everyone.

characters.name: Bulby
characters.persona: A light bulb with a bright idea about every ten seconds.

characters.name: Rocko
characters.persona: A rocket who is always about to take off and never quite does.

characters.name: Dinger
characters.persona: A brass bell who rings in every news item twice.

characters.name: Candi
characters.persona: A birthday cake who throws a party for every day of the week.

characters.name: Bowie
characters.persona: A gift box who cannot keep what is inside a secret.

characters.name: Binky
characters.persona: A trash can who takes everybody's rubbish and still smiles.

characters.name: Lockie
characters.persona: A padlock who keeps every secret and tells a few anyway.

characters.name: Appy
characters.persona: An apple a day, delivered by Appy in person.

characters.name: Puff
characters.persona: A cloud who drifts in, rains on nobody and waves bye.

characters.name: Champ
characters.persona: A trophy who has already won and mentions it constantly.
